exact sequences (this script) == Q1_closed_form.instantiate()
branch x+1 <= j

checks.note: tight for x >= T

checks.statement: a(x) = q^x (K-1)/K > 0 on x <= j
g >= 0 on every branch: q^x/K > 0 (x <= j); g nonincreasing on the tail with g(T) = r_T >= 0; g = 0 for x > T

checks.statement: Delta_x^2 F <= 0 at y=0, x+2 <= j:  d(x+1) = q d(x), q < 1
Delta_x^2 F <= 0 at y=0, junction x = j-1:  D <= q^(j-1)/k1 = q^j/((K-1) eta)
checks.certificate: NO-TAIL: D = q^j/(K eta) < q^j/((K-1)eta).  TAIL: D <= q^j/m (r_T >= 0) and m > eta(K-1) (E > 0), so D < q^j/(eta(K-1))
checks.note: strict on both regimes

checks.statement: Delta_x^2 F = 0 at y=0 inside the tail: d == D constant
checks.note: TIGHT (equality) on every interior tail edge pair

checks.statement: Delta_x^2 F <= 0 at y=0, junction x = T-1:  r_T <= D  <=>  D(m) >= D(m+1)
checks.certificate: identity C6.ID.dT_local; needed only when T < X, i.e. when the closing edge T -> T+1 is on the grid

checks.statement: Delta_x^2 F <= 0 at y=0, x = T:  d(T+1) = 0 <= r_T = d(T)

checks.statement: Delta_x^2 F <= 0 at y >= 1  <=>  g nonincreasing

Delta_y^2 F at y=0:  (r-g)/(K-1) - g = -(K g - r)/(K-1) = 0 on x <= j
checks.note: TIGHT (equality) on the whole geometric branch

checks.statement: K g - r = i D - K eta E (nu^i - 1) =: h(i) on the tail
h concave: h(i+1)-2h(i)+h(i-1) = -K eta E nu^(i-1)(nu-1)^2 <= 0  <=  E >= 0
K g - r >= 0 on the tail: h concave, h(0) = 0, h(m) = (K-1) r_T >= 0, so h(i) >= ((m-i) h(0) + i h(m))/m >= 0 for 0 <= i <= m
checks.certificate: C2.dyy.concave + C2.dyy.endpoints + chord bound for concave sequences

checks.statement: h(m) = (K-1) r_T at D = D(m)  (closing edge g(T) = r(T))
K g - r = 0 for x > T
checks.note: TIGHT

checks.statement: Delta_y^2 F = 0 for y >= 1 (F is affine in y on y >= 1)
checks.note: TIGHT everywhere

checks.statement: D(m) is exactly the slope closing the tail: g(T) = r(T) at T = j+m
NO-TAIL regime (T = +oo, D = D_base): d == D_base for x >= j, g == q^j/K constant, h(i) = i D_base >= 0, and r(X) >= q^j/K > 0 because X - j <= eta(K-1) there
dF/eta <= dG <= dF  <=>  d(x) <= g(x) <= eta d(x)
lower end, x < j:  g - d = (eta-1) g(x+1)/eta >= 0
lower end, j <= x < T:  g - d = (eta-1) g(x+1)/eta >= 0
checks.note: TIGHT iff g(x+1) = 0

checks.statement: lower end, x = T:  g(T) = d(T) = r_T, so dG = dF/eta
checks.note: TIGHT at the LOWER end (this edge realises eta_u = eta)

checks.statement: upper end, x < j:  eta d - g = q^x (eta-1)/(K k1) > 0
checks.note: not tight; ratio dG/dF = k1/(K eta) in (1/eta, 1)

checks.statement: upper end, j <= x < T:  eta d - g = eta E nu^(x-j) >= 0  <=  E >= 0
checks.note: TIGHT iff E = 0, i.e. exactly in the NO-TAIL regime

checks.statement: upper end, x = T:  eta d(T) - g(T) = (eta-1) r_T >= 0
x > T: dF = dG = 0, band degenerate
dF = d(x)+e(x) = g(x+1)/eta = Ghat(x+2)-Ghat(x+1) = dG exactly
checks.certificate: master identity C1.ID.* + Ghat step identity C4.step.*
checks.note: TIGHT at the UPPER end (this edge realises eta_o = 1)

checks.statement: lower end: dF/eta <= dF  <=  dF >= 0 (C1.dx.y1)
dF = g(x), dG = Ghat(x+1)-Ghat(x) = g(x)/eta = dF/eta exactly
checks.note: TIGHT at the LOWER end on EVERY such edge

checks.statement: upper end: g/eta <= g  <=  g >= 0, eta >= 1
y-edges with y >= 1: dG = F(x,y+1)-F(x,y) = dF exactly (G_unbal = Ghat(x+1) + F(x,y) - F(x,1))
checks.note: TIGHT at the UPPER end

checks.statement: x-edges with y >= 2: dG = g(x+1)/eta + dF(x,y) - dF(x,1) = dF(x,y), because dF(x,1) = d+e = g(x+1)/eta
checks.note: TIGHT at the UPPER end

checks.statement: lower end on y >= 2 edges: dF/eta <= dF  <=  dF >= 0 (C1)

eta_u = eta attained on every y-edge y=0->1 and on the closing x-edge x=T at y=0; eta_o = 1 attained on every x-edge at y=1 and on every edge inside y >= 2 (and, in the NO-TAIL regime, on every x-edge at y=0 with x >= j); x-edges at y=0 with x < j are strictly interior with dG/dF = k1/(K eta)
phase1(j+1) == phase2(j+1)  (M = 0)
phase2(T+1) == phase3  (saturation)
phase 1 step:  Ghat(s+1)-Ghat(s) = q^s/(K eta) = g(s)/eta  (s < j)
step at s = j:  = g(j)/eta
step at s = j+1 (phase1 -> phase2):  = g(j+1)/eta
phase 2 step (W = nu^M, M = s-j-1):  Ghat(s+1)-Ghat(s) = g(s)/eta
phase 3 step: Ghat constant = g(s)/eta = 0 for s > T+1
Ghat nondecreasing: every step equals g(s)/eta >= 0 (C1.g.nonneg)

G(x,y) = Ghat(x+y) for y <= 1 by construction, so G depends on |S| = x+y only on the balanced region; the y >= 2 rule agrees at y = 1 (Ghat(x+1) + F(x,1) - F(x,1) = Ghat(x+1)), so G is well defined on the overlap
F(x,K) = 1 for every x (the O-set value is normalized to 1)
F(x,y>=1) = 1 - a(x)(K-y)/(K-1) with a = r - g
F(x,y) <= 1 everywhere (hence on x+y <= K): y = 0 needs r(x) >= 0; y >= 1 needs a(x)(K-y) >= 0, i.e. a = r-g >= 0 (C1.dy.y1)
checks.certificate: C1.dy.y1 + r >= 0 (r nonincreasing with r(T) >= 0, resp. r(X) >= q^j/K in the NO-TAIL regime)

checks.statement: F(K,0) = 1 - r(K) = 1 - q^j + (K-j) D, valid for j <= K <= T
K <= T is automatic: NO-TAIL has T = +oo; TAIL has m >= m_c > eta(K-1) >= eta > K-j, so T = j+m > K
at D = D_base the objective is exactly V_j
objective = V_j + (K-j) E,  E = D - D_base
Bernoulli induction step: nu^(m+1)-1-(m+1)(nu-1) = nu[nu^m-1-m(nu-1)] + m(nu-1)^2 >= 0
Bernoulli bound: B(m) >= eta*m*(nu-1) - m = m/(eta-1) > 0
checks.note: so B(m) > 0 for every integer m >= 1 and eta > 1

checks.statement: D(1) = q^j (K - eta(K-1))/K
D(1) - D_base = -q^j (eta(K-1)-1)(eta-1)/(K eta) < 0 for eta > 1, K >= 2
checks.note: so the staircase never starts at m = 1

checks.statement: E(m) = D(m) - D_base = q^j (m - eta(K-1)) / (K eta B(m))
sign E(m) = sign(m - eta(K-1))  since q^j, K, eta, B(m) > 0.  THE STICKING INEQUALITY:  E(m) > 0  <=>  m > eta(K-1)
m_c = min{m >= 1 : D(m) > D_base} = floor(eta(K-1)) + 1; first staircase step at n_c = K + j + m_c
checks.certificate: C6.E.sign (m_c is the least integer > eta(K-1))

checks.statement: lim_{m->oo} D(m) = D_base (E(m) -> 0+), so the excess is NOT produced in the limit m -> oo: E(m) = q^j(m - eta(K-1))/(K eta B(m)) with B(m) ~ eta nu^m, so E(m) ~ q^j m /(K eta^2 nu^m) -> 0+ from ABOVE for m > eta(K-1); sup_m D(m) is attained at a finite m*
r_T = q^j - m D(m) = q^j (nu^m(eta K - m) - eta K)/(K B(m))

hence at ANY m that maximises D over the available range the two junction conditions of C2 hold: r_T >= 0 (needs m-1 in range, true since TAIL forces m >= m_c >= 2) and r_T <= D (needs m+1 in range, i.e. T < X; when T = X the closing edge is off-grid and the condition is vacuous)
D(m) >= D(m+1)  <=>  nu^m (eta K - 1 - m) <= K(eta-1)  (the defining equation of m*)
m* = argmax_m D(m) = min{m >= 1 : nu^m (eta K - 1 - m) <= K(eta-1)}, and m* <= ceil(eta K) - 1 always
checks.certificate: C6.ID.step_sign + unimodality of nu^m (eta K-1-m) in m (single sign change of its derivative) + the m=1 check 2 eta (K-1) > K; sweep-confirmed below
checks.note: hand argument, oracle only on the sweep

checks.statement: m_c > K - j on the whole domain: m_c > eta(K-1) >= eta > K-j (K >= 2 and eta > K-j).  Hence at n = 2K (X = K, m ranges over 1..K-j) no m reaches m_c, D = D_base, and the value is exactly V_j
NO-TAIL  <=>  X - j <= eta(K-1)  <=>  n <= K + j + floor(eta(K-1)) = n_c - 1; TAIL <=> n >= n_c = K + j + m_c
checks.certificate: C6.E.sign applied to every m in 1..X-j

checks.statement: TASKS10 premise (c) FAILS for this family: for n >= n_c the LP value is V_j + (K-j) max_m E(m) > V_j and it is nondecreasing in n, so it cannot converge down to rho_K = min_j V_j
V_j(eta) = V_{j+1}(eta) exactly at eta = K - j (left endpoint of segment j, right endpoint of segment j+1)
V_j(eta) = V_{j-1}(eta) exactly at eta = K - j + 1 (right endpoint of segment j)

so rho_K = min_t V_t is continuous across integer eta and the active index switches there; at n = 2K the closed form value is V_j with j = K+1-ceil(eta) (C6.mc_gt_Kj), matching rho_K on the sweep below
48 exact-rational (K, j, eta) points: all branch conditions of C1/C2/C3/C5 hold, m_c = floor(eta(K-1))+1, E(m*) > 0, m_c > K-j, value(n=2K) = V_j = rho_K, D(m) unimodal in m, B(m) > 0
checks.note: 4/48 points refute m* = ceil(eta K)-1

checks.statement: inherited [CONJECTURE] m* = ceil(eta K)-1 REFUTED at 4 of 48 sweep points (those with frac(eta K) small); the correct rule is m* = min{m : nu^m (eta K - 1 - m) <= K(eta-1)} <= ceil(eta K)-1
checks.note: auxiliary conjecture of N4/Q1; the closed form itself uses the direct argmax and is unaffected

checks.statement: every LP constraint (monotone, submodular, band, F<=1, O-indep, normalization) holds on the full 2D grid at n = 2K, n = K+T and n = K+T+3 for the listed (K, j, eta)

key_identities.master: a(x) - a(x+1) = g(x+1)/eta with a = r-g; hence Delta_x F(x,y>=1) = (K-y) g(x+1)/(eta (K-1))
key_identities.rT: r_T = q^j - m D(m) = q^j (nu^m(eta K - m) - eta K)/(K B(m))
key_identities.mstar: m* = min{m : nu^m (eta K - 1 - m) <= K(eta-1)} <= ceil(eta K)-1
key_identities.regime: NO-TAIL <=> X - j <= eta(K-1); TAIL <=> n >= n_c = K+j+m_c
